OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.76 (1 Oct 45) CIS
(SCAPIN - 79)
1 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Confiscation of September 29th Edition, Toyo Keizai Shimpo.
1. The Japanese Imperial Government will issue the necessary orders to effect the confiscation of all distributed copies of the 29 September 1945 issue of Tokyo Keizai Shimpo.
2. Confiscated copies will be submitted to Press, Pictorial, and Broadcast Division, Civil Censorship Detachment, 6th Floor, Radio Tokyo Building, for disposition.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair.
/t/ HAROLD FAIR,
Lt. Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
